opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.plain_summary: We tested whether a model trained on college football's own opening-line errors helps predict which side covers the NFL opener, now checked back to 2013 instead of just 2020. The extra signal points the right direction almost every year, but it is still too small and too noisy to say for sure it helps -- so the pick stays exactly as it would be without it.
